queries_run: STMicroelectronics silicon carbide gallium nitride substitute technology threat 2026

findings.claim: STM 20-F 自述半導體產業技術變動快、產品週期短、價格侵蝕大，公司財務表現取決於能否掌握 AI、量子等新技術機會；未點名具體替代技術。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 3.D Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The semiconductor industry is highly competitive and characterized by constant and rapid technological change, short product lifecycles, significant price erosion and evolving standards. Accordingly, our financial performance and future prospects depend to a significant extent on our ability to develop and maximize the opportunities offered by new technologies available to our industry, such as AI or quantum.

note: 搜尋一次，未找到點名具體替代技術（SiC/GaN 被取代）的 2026 來源；搜尋摘要顯示 GaN 與 SiC 被描述為互補/並存，無可逐字引用原文，故未列入。

axis_meta.name: 替代技術
axis_meta.question: 是否存在正在崛起、可能取代本標的核心產品/技術的替代方案？
